en.name: Black pudding
en.summary: Black pudding is blood, fat and cereal cooked in a casing — already cooked when you buy it, but not cured or preserved in any meaningful way. From the butcher it keeps 2–3 days in the fridge; a vacuum pack keeps to its date and 3–5 days once opened. Frozen, 1–2 months.
en.pantry: Black pudding is a chilled food and has no cupboard life. It contains blood and cereal and almost no salt or acid by cured-meat standards, so nothing about it is preserved: it is a fresh cooked sausage that happens to be dark. Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, follow the 2-hour rule when it is out, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F), and always fry or grill it through before eating, even though it was cooked at the maker.
en.fridge: A chilled ring or slice from a butcher keeps 2–3 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in its casing — that is the published figure for fresh or smoked sausage and the right bracket here. A vacuum-packed supermarket ring keeps to its printed date while sealed; once opened, wrap it and use it within 3–5 days. Cooked slices left over from breakfast are a cooked meat dish and keep 3–4 days at 4 °C or below. Store it on a lower shelf where it cannot drip on anything, and keep it wrapped: black pudding picks up and gives off strong smells.
en.freezer: Black pudding freezes well for 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), a figure borrowed from what is published for fully cooked smoked sausage. Slice it before freezing rather than freezing the ring whole, interleave the slices with paper, and bag them flat — that way you can take out two slices for a breakfast instead of thawing the lot. Fry the slices straight from frozen over a lower heat so the outside does not scorch before the middle is hot. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
en.thawing: Cook slices straight from frozen over a moderate heat, or thaw them in the fridge overnight. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze once cooked from frozen.
spoilage: A slimy or sticky casing, or slime on a cut face.
A sour or putrid smell rather than a savoury, faintly metallic one.
Any mould on the casing or the cut end.
A swollen vacuum pack, or grey-green patches in the filling.
tips: Slice before freezing so you can cook two pieces at a time.
Fry from frozen over a lower heat; high heat scorches the outside.
Wrap it well — it flavours everything near it in the fridge.
Cook it through even though it was cooked when you bought it.

faq.q: How long does black pudding keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 2–3 days from a butcher's counter at 4 °C or below. A vacuum pack keeps to its printed date sealed, and 3–5 days once opened.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C. Slice it first, interleave with paper, and fry the slices from frozen.
Yes, but it is not cured or preserved — it is a fresh cooked sausage. Always fry or grill it through before eating.

faq.q: How long do cooked black pudding leftovers keep?
faq.a: Treat them as a cooked meat dish: 3–4 days at 4 °C or below, covered.

zh.name: 英式血腸
zh.summary: 英式血腸是血、油脂和穀物灌進腸衣煮熟的香腸，買到時就已經是熟的，但完全談不上醃製或保存。肉舖現切的冷藏可放 2～3 天；真空包未開封依標示日期，開封後 3～5 天。冷凍 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 血腸是冷藏食品，沒有櫥櫃保存這回事。它含血和穀物，以醃製肉品的標準來說幾乎不含鹽也不含酸，所以裡面沒有任何東西在「保存」它：它就是一條顏色很深的新鮮熟香腸。請放 4 °C 以下，離開冰箱後守 2 小時原則（超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時），而且即使它在工廠就煮過了，吃之前仍然要煎或烤透。
zh.fridge: 肉舖買的冷藏血腸連腸衣放 4 °C 以下可存 2～3 天——這是「生鮮或煙燻香腸」的公告值，用在這裡量級正確。超市的真空包未開封時依標示日期；一旦開封，包好並在 3～5 天內用完。早餐吃剩的熟血腸片屬於熟肉料理，在 4 °C 以下可放 3～4 天。請放在較低層、不會滴到別的東西的位置，並且包好：血腸既會吸味也會散味。
zh.freezer: 血腸很耐凍，在 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月，這個數字借自「全熟煙燻香腸」的公告值。請先切片再冷凍，不要整條凍，片與片之間夾紙、壓平裝袋——這樣早餐要煎兩片就拿兩片，不必解凍一整條。直接從冷凍以較小的火慢煎，外層才不會在中心熱透前就焦掉。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 切片直接從冷凍以中小火煎，或放冷藏隔夜解凍。不要放室溫解凍；從冷凍煎過的也不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或腐臭，而不是帶點金屬味的鹹香。
真空包鼓脹，或內餡出現灰綠色斑塊。
tips: 冷凍前先切片，之後要煎幾片拿幾片。
從冷凍以小火慢煎；大火會讓外層先焦。
包好——它會讓冰箱裡旁邊的東西都變味。
即使買來就是熟的，吃之前還是要煎透。

faq.a: 肉舖買的在 4 °C 以下 2～3 天。真空包未開封依標示日期，開封後 3～5 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。先切片、中間夾紙，直接從冷凍下鍋煎。
是熟的，但它沒有經過醃製或保存處理——它就是一條新鮮熟香腸。吃之前一定要煎或烤透。

faq.q: 煎過的血腸剩下來可以放多久？
faq.a: 當成熟肉料理看待：加蓋放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。
